flora: Dense Araucarian forest (dark green, overlapping canopy)
Thick mats of liverworts and mosses on fallen logs
Ginkgoales with heavy leaf-litter at the water's edge
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; claustrophobic and ancient; heavy atmospheric mist rising from the still water surface.

visual_logic.composition: A view from within the tree line looking out onto a dark, mirror-still lake. The foreground is dominated by rotting, mossy wood.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated forest floor with layers of dark, decaying organic matter.
